Breaks_Stealth.name: Loud / Obvious
Breaks_Stealth.description: Executing this action instantly removes any active camouflage or stealth statuses.

Provokes_Reaction.name: Provokes Reaction
Provokes_Reaction.description: Leaves the user open to opportunity attacks from adjacent enemies.

Requires_LOS.name: Requires Line of Sight
Requires_LOS.description: Requires an unobstructed physical path to the target to be cast.

Requires_Grounded.name: Grounded
Requires_Grounded.description: The entity must be physically touching a solid surface to execute this.

Ignores_Cover.name: Ignores Cover
Ignores_Cover.description: This action's accuracy or effects are not mitigated by physical cover.

Usable_While_Grappled.name: Usable While Grappled
Usable_While_Grappled.description: Bypasses the standard skill restrictions applied by the Grappled status.
